title: poa nemoralis subsp. montana
intro: Poa nemoralis subsp. montana, commonly known as Alpine Meadow-grass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Poa nemoralis subsp. montana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing digestive issues, reducing pain, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
